propositions: Test walks entire corpus (884 units × 2 renders = ~1768 pandoc spawns) in single monolithic function, with measured cost of 91.6s idle and 504.8s under CPU saturation, exceeding CI's 300s per-test timeout on resource-constrained macOS lane.
pytest-timeout with thread method kills xdist worker via os._exit(1) when per-test budget is exceeded, producing worker crash with no traceback rather than test failure.
Test cost is unbounded and load-dependent; corpus growth extends execution time of single test case rather than adding new cases, making timeout failures structurally inevitable as corpus expands.

Fix chunks 884 units into fixed-size batches (constant _EQUIVALENCE_CHUNK=40), parametrizes test across chunks, and spreads work across workers, bounding individual test cost to ~4.2s idle with 13x headroom under saturation.
All 884 units remain compared against oracle with real pandoc at _EQUIVALENCE_STRIDE=1; byte-identity property is untouched and validated by new coverage guard test.
